# OneAgent Version Compliance

Shows installed OneAgent versions by host. Baseline values (latest OneAgent release and ESS oldest supported) are read dynamically from a daily Dynatrace workflow event named `OneAgentBaseline|<latest>|<oldest>|<fetched_at>`.

1.title: Most Recent OneAgent Release (Workflow)
1.query: fetch events | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|") | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|") | fields most_recent_version = arrayElement(parts, 1)

2.title: Oldest Supported OneAgent Version (ESS, Workflow)
2.query: fetch events | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|") | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|") | fields oldest_supported_version = arrayElement(parts, 2)

3.title: Hosts by OneAgent Version
3.query: fetch dt.entity.host | filter isNotNull(installerVersion) | summarize hosts = count(), by: {installerVersion} | sort installerVersion desc

4.title: OneAgent Versions by Host
4.query: fetch dt.entity.host | filter isNotNull(installerVersion) | fields host = `entity.name`, host_id = id, oneagent_version = installerVersion, monitoring_mode = monitoringMode, state | fieldsAdd host_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(oneagent_version, "."), 1)), join_key = "baseline" | join [ fetch events | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|") | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|") | fields oldest_supported_version = arrayElement(parts, 2) | fieldsAdd oldest_supported_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(oldest_supported_version, "."), 1)), join_key = "baseline" ], on: join_key | fieldsAdd support_alert = host_sprint < right.oldest_supported_sprint | fields host, host_id, oneagent_version, support_alert, monitoring_mode, state | sort host asc

5.title: Baseline Fetch Time (Workflow)
5.query: fetch events | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|") | sort timestamp desc | limit 1 | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|") | fields fetched_at = arrayElement(parts, 3)
